name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
label: Quest

intro: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit is a sacred trial of cunning and stealth set before aspiring druids. Initiates must venture into the nearby Stormrage Barrow Den to recover three ancient relics while slipping past hostile, enraged spirits. Passing this spiritual rite proves one's mastery over the feline virtues of stealth, ferocity, and cunning, earning the blessing to wield the cat form.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.
Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.
I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young adventurer.
